primary_endpoint: paired completed-work cost including all charged attempts and reasoning
split_unit: independent event or scoped site-morning; keep frames and adjacent bursts together
freeze: Pin corpus, labels, candidate, rubric, unchanged decision adapter and input media hashes before any replay. Exclude every development group.
pairing: Same model/runtime, response service tier, billing context class, six cameras, three-frame media and synthesis policy. Record run order, repeats, cache state and every charged attempt; unknown conditions block review.
acceptance: No lost event detection or missed independently labeled held-out event
No UNKNOWN-to-absence conversion or safety failure
Completed valid outputs with unchanged decisions and full schema
Positive matched-work savings across reported unknown-cache-write bounds
sample_limit: 30 independent groups per stratum is a screening minimum, not a powered equivalence study. Report uncertainty and arrange a separately preregistered power analysis before a production trial.
